title: MarkAsExisting Command
description: Move objects onto X-EXIST and stamp forsk:kind=existing with forsk:level=0 and forsk:id x01…. Removes forsk:generated so clear_generated will not delete them. Ids omitted uses the current selection. Empty selection with no ids is refused.

ids.description: Object GUIDs to mark. Omit or pass an empty list to use the current selection.

target_layer.description: Layer to move objects onto. Created if missing. Default X-EXIST, color RGB 140,140,140.
